policies.title: Current MFA nationality schedule: visa-free short visitors
policies.summary: The current MFA diplomatic-post schedule expressly lists these nationalities as visa-exempt. China is added separately only because a current mutual ordinary-passport agreement expressly establishes its exemption.
conditions: The MFA page says the listed nationalities may stay visa-free for one year. China is limited by its mutual ordinary-passport agreement to a single stay of up to 30 days and an aggregate 90 days in 180 days.

This is only the ordinary short-visitor nationality baseline. It does not establish work, residence, study, journalism, diplomatic, official, service, crew, transit, refugee, stateless, special travel-document, dual-nationality, or purpose-specific treatment.
A valid third-country visa or residence permit can create a separate 90-in-180 visa-free route under Ordinance No. 256; that document/status exception is not a passport-wide classification.
The Law permits refusal for missing documents, bans, false data, lack of insurance or funds, security, public-order or foreign-policy grounds. Border admission remains case-specific.
Foreign citizens and stateless persons may enter Abkhazia only via Zugdidi and the Tskhinvali region only via Gori; other directions are prohibited. This territorial rule is not nationality-specific.

policies.title: Named eVisa countries: supporting-document cohort
policies.summary: The live official eVisa country page explicitly assigns these passport/country entries to the cohort that is eligible only with a valid Schengen or OECD visa or residence-permit supporting document.
conditions: The portal requires a valid supporting document: a Schengen visa, a valid visa from an OECD member, or a valid Schengen/OECD residence permit.

For tourist eVisa applications it lists biometric photo, passport/travel-document copy, supporting document, accommodation proof, return ticket unless using other transport, travel insurance and proof of funds.

The electronic-visa statute requires an application through the MFA's special webpage while abroad; the portal describes eVisa as short-stay only and its FAQ says issuance follows email delivery and printing.

The current application page requires the travel document to remain valid at least three months after the requested Georgian visa. Where an Israeli visa is relied on at the border, it says a physical Israeli visa stamp is mandatory and an Israeli electronic visa is not accepted.

This does not treat a third-country visa/residence permit as passport-wide visa-free entry; it is an eVisa eligibility/document condition. Other purpose, special-document, admission, security and occupied-territory rules remain outside the classification.

application.label: Georgia eVisa application
application.processingTime: The statutory maximum for a short-term electronic visa is five working days after a complete webpage application.
steps: Apply from outside Georgia through the eVisa portal using the passport/travel document selected for travel.
Upload the cohort-specific supporting document and the tourist documents required by the portal, then complete payment.
Complete the mandatory DuVerify step sent by email within 24 hours, then receive and print the electronic visa for border examination.

policies.title: Named eVisa countries: standard-document cohort
policies.summary: The live official eVisa country page explicitly names these passport/country entries in its standard document cohort for tourist or business eVisa applications.
conditions: For tourists the portal lists biometric photo, passport/travel-document copy, accommodation proof, return ticket unless using other transport, travel insurance and proof of funds.
For business visitors it lists biometric photo, passport/travel-document copy, accommodation proof, return ticket unless using other transport, travel insurance and proof of travel purpose.

The electronic-visa statute requires an application through the MFA's special webpage while abroad; the portal describes eVisa as short-stay only and its FAQ says issuance follows email delivery and printing.

The current application page requires the travel document to remain valid at least three months after the requested Georgian visa. Where an Israeli visa is relied on at the border, it says a physical Israeli visa stamp is mandatory and an Israeli electronic visa is not accepted.

This does not treat a third-country visa/residence permit as passport-wide visa-free entry; it is an eVisa eligibility/document condition. Other purpose, special-document, admission, security and occupied-territory rules remain outside the classification.

application.label: Georgia eVisa application
application.processingTime: The statutory maximum for a short-term electronic visa is five working days after a complete webpage application.
steps: Apply from outside Georgia through the eVisa portal using the passport/travel document selected for travel.
Upload the tourist or business documents stated for the cohort, then complete payment.
Complete the mandatory DuVerify step sent by email within 24 hours, then receive and print the electronic visa for border examination.

policies.title: Named eVisa countries: minimal-document cohort
policies.summary: The live official eVisa country page explicitly names these passport/country entries in its third document cohort, which lists a biometric photo and travel-document copy.
conditions: The portal's third cohort lists a biometric photo and copy of a valid travel document/passport. It does not state that these are the only documents a case or border examination may require.

The electronic-visa statute requires an application through the MFA's special webpage while abroad; the portal describes eVisa as short-stay only and its FAQ says issuance follows email delivery and printing.

The current application page requires the travel document to remain valid at least three months after the requested Georgian visa. Where an Israeli visa is relied on at the border, it says a physical Israeli visa stamp is mandatory and an Israeli electronic visa is not accepted.
This does not establish visa-free entry or a visa-on-arrival route. Other purpose, special-document, admission, security and occupied-territory rules remain outside the classification.

application.label: Georgia eVisa application
application.processingTime: The statutory maximum for a short-term electronic visa is five working days after a complete webpage application.
steps: Apply from outside Georgia through the eVisa portal using the passport/travel document selected for travel.
Upload the documents stated by the portal and complete payment.
Complete the mandatory DuVerify step sent by email within 24 hours, then receive and print the electronic visa for border examination.

policies.title: Georgian citizens: entry without permit
policies.summary: Georgia's entry law expressly allows a Georgian citizen to enter Georgia at any time without a permit; this is citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa category.
conditions: The law says a Georgian citizen enters temporarily with a Georgian passport, a return certificate, or another treaty-recognised substitute. This policy records citizenship only and does not decide passport issuance, dual citizenship, departure limits, identity checks or other formalities.
